layout.normalized_edit_instruction: Keep the source image <frame>0</frame> unchanged. Refine only its scene layout into distinct architectural regions for exterior wall cladding, roof masses or roof planes, glazing and windows, doors, porch, stairs, railings, columns, ground, and sky. Preserve the exact existing geometry and composition.
layout.prompt:
A 3d_render of a two-story <house 1> with a coastal aesthetic, featuring dark gray shingle siding and crisp white trim. The <house 1> is set against a minimalist background of a flat, olive-green <ground 1> and a pale, clear <sky 1>. The <house 1> has a gabled roof with dark shingles.

On the upper floor, the image-left side of the <house 1> has two small, white-trimmed windows. A central gable features a larger window flanked by two smaller ones. To the image-right, a larger gable contains three side-by-side windows. A small, white-trimmed window is visible on a recessed portion of the second floor.

The first floor of the <house 1> includes a covered porch on the image-right side. The porch is supported by white columns and enclosed by a black railing. A set of gray stairs with black handrails leads up to the porch from the image-right. The porch has two white doors and several windows. To the image-left of the porch, the first floor has three white-trimmed windows.

The <house 1> casts a long, dark <shadow 1> onto the <ground 1> to its image-left. The <ground 1> is a vast, empty expanse of green that meets the <sky 1> at a sharp horizon line. The <sky 1> is a gradient of pale blue to white.

regions.label: context.house-1#000
regions.prompt: Two-story coastal-style house with dark gray cedar shingle siding and crisp white trim. The dark charcoal gabled roof features two prominent front-facing gables with white decorative truss-like patterns in the peaks. A covered front porch with a white-pillared portico and black railings spans the right side, accessed by a set of light gray stairs with black handrails. The windows are multi-paned with white frames; two large tripartite windows sit on the upper right, while smaller single and double-hung windows are distributed across the left facade and lower level. A white front door is visible under the porch roof. The house sits on a light gray concrete foundation.

regions.label: roof.roof-1#001
regions.prompt: Dark gray shingled roof with multiple gables and white trim. A large, flat-sloped section on the image-left leads to a central gabled peak featuring a white-trimmed dormer with decorative truss-like bargeboards and three small windows. To the image-right, a larger forward-facing gable also has white decorative bargeboards over a set of three large windows. A lower, smaller gabled porch roof extends from the center-bottom, mirroring the dark shingle texture and white trim style. All roof lines are defined by thick white fascia boards.

regions.label: wall.shingle-siding-1#002
regions.prompt: honed travertine stone cladding, buff cream tone, subtle horizontal banding, matte finish

regions.prompt: Narrow, vertical window with a thick white frame and a single horizontal sash dividing it into two panes. The glass panes have a warm, peach-colored interior glow. The window is set into a wall of dark grey shingles.

regions.label: glazing.window-2#004
regions.prompt: Tall, narrow rectangular window with a thick white frame and a single horizontal sash dividing it into upper and lower panes. The glass panes reflect a warm, light-orange interior glow. The window is set against a dark grey shingled wall.

regions.prompt: Small rectangular window with a thick white frame and a white cross-shaped muntin dividing the glass into four panes. The glass has a warm, yellowish-tan tint. The window is set into a wall of dark gray shingles.

regions.label: glazing.window-6#006

Each window is divided into four panes by thin white muntins, with a horizontal sash bar at the center. The glass reflects a uniform, light gray tone. The white trim includes a continuous top header and three distinct bottom sills, one for each window unit.

regions.label: glazing.window-10#010
regions.prompt: Three side-by-side rectangular windows with white frames and thin white muntins dividing each into four panes. The windows are set within a larger white trim unit, featuring a continuous top header and individual sills for each pane. The glass reflects a warm, brownish interior.

regions.label: door.door-1#011
regions.prompt: White front door featuring a large upper glass pane divided by thin white muntins and a solid lower panel. A small dark handle is positioned on the image-left side. The door is set within a white frame, with dark grey shingles visible on the image-left and a black railing at the bottom.

regions.label: context.porch-1#012
regions.prompt: Elevated grey porch with a black metal railing and a set of stairs leading down to the image-right. The railing features thin vertical balusters and thick square posts topped with white pyramidal caps. A white-trimmed gabled roof covers the porch area, supported by square white columns. Behind the railing, two white front doors with multi-pane glass windows are visible against grey shingle siding. The stairs have grey treads and a matching black railing on both sides.

regions.label: context.stairs-1#013
regions.prompt: A set of light gray wooden stairs descends towards the bottom-right corner. The staircase features a black railing on its left side, composed of thin vertical balusters and a matching black handrail. Two white square posts with tiered caps anchor the railing at the top and midway down. The stairs are positioned against a light gray foundation wall on the left.

regions.label: context.railing-1#014
regions.prompt: Black wooden railing system on a light gray porch and staircase. On the porch level, a horizontal section of railing with thin vertical balusters is anchored by a thick square post topped with a white pyramidal cap. A matching railing descends along the staircase, featuring a slanted handrail supported by vertical balusters and punctuated by two square posts with identical white pyramidal caps. The railing is set against a background of dark gray shingle siding and white porch columns.

regions.label: ground.ground-1#015
regions.prompt: Expansive, flat olive-green lawn with a uniform, finely textured surface. On the image-left, a large, dark, sharp-edged shadow of a house is cast across the grass, extending from the base of the structure toward the left edge. The lawn surrounds the lower portion of a gray-shingled house, meeting its light-gray concrete foundation and the bottom of a set of white stairs with black railings.

regions.label: context.shadow-1#016
regions.prompt: A dark, elongated shadow cast across a textured olive-green lawn. The shadow's left edge is sharp and straight, while its right edge features a series of parallel, diagonal lines created by the railing of a nearby structure. The shadow originates from the base of a light-gray concrete foundation visible on the image-right.

regions.label: sky.sky-1#017
regions.prompt: Clear, pale sky with a soft gradient from a light bluish-white at the top to a hazy, near-white at the horizon.
